name: rasdaemon

event_database.rationale: rasdaemon persists hardware-error events in its SQLite database.

budget.rationale: Durable data storage ceiling is derived from the expected working set and raises an alarm before host capacity is threatened.

event_database_wal.rationale: SQLite WAL sidecar counted while rasdaemon is live.

budget.rationale: Regenerable storage is retained for 30 days and reclaimed by age; the window is the workload retention requirement.

event_database_shm.rationale: SQLite shared-memory sidecar counted while rasdaemon is live.

budget.rationale: Regenerable storage is retained for 30 days and reclaimed by age; the window is the workload retention requirement.

storage.rationale: rasdaemon owns its Linux event database and live SQLite sidecars.

description: AMD/Intel hardware error capture daemon (memory ECC, PCIe AER, MCE) — writes events to /var/lib/rasdaemon/ras-mc_event.db
installHint: Install rasdaemon via your package manager and enable the systemd unit (rasdaemon.service).

macos.evidence: A mechanism exists but no implementation is wired for this host OS.

windows.evidence: A mechanism exists but no implementation is wired for this host OS.
